news_items.title: Serena & Lily Expands Partnership with Bamboo Rose to Enhance Retail Planning with TotalPLM™
news_items.summary: Serena & Lily has expanded its partnership with Bamboo Rose to integrate AI-powered planning with the TotalPLM platform, aiming to modernize retail planning and streamline operations.
news_items.relevance_reason: The integration of AI-powered planning tools is highly relevant for an AI visual content company, as it enhances digital transformation and operational efficiency.
key_insights: Integration of AI-powered planning with TotalPLM platform.
Expected business impact of $3–8M over three years.

news_items.title: Serena & Lily Just Dropped Its Fall 2024 Collection
news_items.summary: House Beautiful covers Serena & Lily’s Fall 2024 collection, highlighting over 100 new pieces with a focus on the brand’s 'coastal cool' aesthetic and significant discounts.
news_items.relevance_reason: The launch of a new collection with a strong visual identity is relevant for creating lifestyle imagery and marketing content.
key_insights: Launch of over 100 new pieces in the Fall 2024 collection.
Items introduced at more than 20% off.
